```{r}

# Define the path to forward and reverse reads
fnFs <- sort(list.files(path = "./", pattern = "_R1_.*fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

fnRs <- sort(list.files(path = "./", pattern = "_R2_.*fastq.gz", full.names = TRUE))

# Plot quality profiles for the first few files to assess reads quality
plotQualityProfile(fnFs[1:2])
plotQualityProfile(fnRs[1:2])

# Check quality
quality.plot.F <- plotQualityProfile(fnFs, aggregate = TRUE)
quality.plot.R <- plotQualityProfile(fnRs, aggregate = TRUE)
```


```{r}

# Ensure the "filtered" directory exists
if (!dir.exists("./filtered")) {
  dir.create("./filtered")
}

# Define primer sequences
R1_primer <- "GTGCCAGC[AC]GCCGCGGTAA"
R2_primer <- "GGACTAC[ACT][CGT]GGGT[AT]TCTAAT"
R1_primer.rc <- "TTACCGCGGC[TG]GCTGGCAC"
R2_primer.rc <- "ATTAGA[AT]ACCC[CGT][AGT]GTAGTCC"

# Checking for primers in untrimmed reads
message ('checking for primers in untrimmed reads')
test_seqs.R1 <- getSequences(fnFs[1])
length(test_seqs.R1)

R1_matches_5prime <- data.frame(str_locate(test_seqs.R1, R1_primer))
print(table(R1_matches_5prime))
print(sum(table(R1_matches_5prime)) / length(test_seqs.R1) * 100)


R1_matches_3prime <- data.frame(str_locate(test_seqs.R1, R2_primer.rc))
print(table(R1_matches_3prime))

test_seqs.R2 <- getSequences(fnRs[1])
length(test_seqs.R2)
R2_matches_5prime <- data.frame(str_locate(test_seqs.R2, R2_primer))
print(table(R2_matches_5prime))
print(sum(table(R2_matches_5prime)) / length(test_seqs.R2)* 100)

R2_matches_3prime <- data.frame(str_locate(test_seqs.R2, R1_primer.rc))
print(table(R2_matches_3prime))


# Define filtered file paths
filtFs <- file.path("./filtered", paste0(basename(fnFs)))
filtRs <- file.path("./filtered", paste0(basename(fnRs)))



# Filter and trim sequences (including removal of 5' primers/adapters if present)
out <- filterAndTrim(fnFs, filtFs, fnRs, filtRs, truncLen = c(240,200), maxN = 0, maxEE = c(2,2), truncQ = 2, rm.phix= TRUE, compress = TRUE, multithread = 6)

print("Filter and trim output:")
print(out)


# Check if trimming was successful 
plotQualityProfile(filtFs[1:2])
plotQualityProfile(filtRs[1:2])

message("Checking for primers in remaining trimmed reads")

test_seqs.R1.trimmed <- getSequences(filtFs[1])
R1_matches_5prime.trimmed <- data.frame(str_locate(test_seqs.R1.trimmed, R1_primer))
print(table(R1_matches_5prime.trimmed))

```

```{r}
saveRDS(errF, file = "errF_sampled.rds")
errR <- learnErrors(filtRs, multithread = TRUE)
saveRDS(errR, file = "errR_sampled.rds")

# Plot error rates
plotFerr <- plotErrors(errF, nominalQ= TRUE)
```

# Denoise and Dereplicate sequences
```{r}
# Set up lists with correct length and names
sample.names <- sapply(strsplit(basename(fnFs), "_"), `[`, 1)

names(filtFs) <- sample.names
names(filtRs) <- sample.names

mergers <- vector("list", length(sample.names))
names(mergers)<- sample.names
dadaFs <- mergers
dadaRs <- mergers

# Process reads serially
timestamp()
for (sam in sample.names) {
  message("Processing sample:", sam)
  
  # Check if the sample exist in filtFs and filtRs
  if(sam %in% names(filtFs) && sam %in%names(filtRs)) {
    derepF <- derepFastq(filtFs[[sam]])
    derepR <- derepFastq(filtRs[[sam]])
    dadaF <- dada(derepF, err = errF, multithread = TRUE)
    dadaFs[[sam]] <- dadaF
    dadaR <- dada (derepR, err = errR, multithread = TRUE)
    dadaRs[[sam]] <- dadaR
    merger <- mergePairs(dadaF, derepF, dadaR, derepR, verbose = TRUE)
    mergers[[sam]]<- merger
  } else {
    message("Sample", sam, "not found in filtered file list.")
  }
  
  
}
timestamp()

# Save results
saveRDS(dadaFs, "dadaFs_sampled.rds")
saveRDS(dadaRs, "dadaRs_sampled.rds")
saveRDS(mergers, "mergers_sampled.rds")
```





# Generate ASV and Taxonomy tables
```{r}
# Loading pre-processed data
dadaFs <- readRDS("dadaFs_sampled.rds")
dadaRs <- readRDS("dadaRs_sampled.rds")
mergers <- readRDS("mergers_sampled.rds")

# Create a sequence table
seqtab <- makeSequenceTable(mergers)
saveRDS(seqtab, "seqtab_sampled.rds")
seqtab <- readRDS("seqtab_sampled.rds")

# Check the structure of the sequence table
print("Sequence table structure:")
str(seqtab)

# Check sequence lengths (Identify the length distribution of the merged sequences)
Sequence_lengths <- table(nchar(getSequences(seqtab)))
print("Sequence lengths:")
print(Sequence_lengths)
write.table(Sequence_lengths, "seqlengths.tab", row.names = F, col.names = F, sep = "\t", quote = F)


#Filter Sequences by length to retain those within the expected range (250-256 bp)
seqtab<- seqtab[, nchar(colnames(seqtab)) %in% seq(250,256)]
saveRDS(seqtab, "seqtabfilt_sampled.rds")
seqtab<- readRDS("seqtabfilt_sampled.rds")


# Remove Chimeric sequences and save results
seqtab.nochim <- removeBimeraDenovo(seqtab, method= "consensus", multithread=TRUE, verbose=TRUE)
saveRDS(seqtab.nochim, "seqtabnochim_sampled.rds")
seqtab.nochim<- readRDS("seqtabnochim_sampled.rds")

# Check the structure of the no-chimera sequence table
print("No-chimera sequence table structure:")
str(seqtab.nochim)

#Track the number of reads through each step of the Pipeline
getN <- function(x) sum(getUniques(x))
track <- data.frame(
  input = out[, "reads.in"],
  filtered = out[, "reads.out"],
  denoised = sapply(dadaFs, getN),
  merged = sapply(mergers, getN),
  tabled = rowSums(seqtab),
  nochim = rowSums(seqtab.nochim)
)


# Calculate and Save Percent of Reads Retained
track$percent<- signif(track$nochim / track$input * 100, 4)
write.table(track, "tracked.tab", sep="\t", quote =F, row.names= T, col.names=NA)
```



# Assign Taxonomy
```{r}

# Define the path to the SILVA files
silva_path <- "/local/cqls/db/dada2"

taxonomy_file <- file.path(silva_path, "silva_nr99_v138.1_train_set.fa.gz")
species_file <- file.path(silva_path, "silva_species_assignment_v138.1.fa.gz")

# Set seed to ensure reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Assign taxonomy using the correct files
taxa <- assignTaxonomy(seqtab.nochim, taxonomy_file, multithread = TRUE, add) 
taxa <- addSpecies(taxa, species_file)

# Convert the taxonomy table to a data frame to make adjustments
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(taxa)

# Fill in missing Genus with Family, and missing Family with Order
tax_table_df <- tax_table_df %>%
  mutate(
    Genus = ifelse(is.na(Genus), Family, Genus),  
    Family = ifelse(is.na(Family), Order, Family) 
  )

# Convert the adjusted data frame back to a tax_table object
taxa <- as.matrix(tax_table_df)

# Save the adjusted taxonomy object
saveRDS(taxa, "taxa_sampled.rds")

```


# Phyloseq object
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyverse)
library(microViz)

# Load pre-processed OTU table and taxonomy table
seqtab.nochim.full <- readRDS("seqtabnochim_sampled.rds")
taxa <- readRDS("taxa_sampled.rds")

# Load the updated metadata
metadata <- read.csv("Almond_Updated_Metadata.csv", header = TRUE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


# Assign 'ID' column as rownames for metadata
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$ID

# Ensure OTU table sample names align with metadata rownames
rownames(seqtab.nochim.full) <- metadata$ID

# Transform the Treatment column to a factor with proper labels
metadata <- metadata %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c(0, 1), labels = c("Cracker", "Almond"))
  )

#  Convert metadata to a phyloseq-compatible sample_data object
sample_data_object <- sample_data(metadata)


# Create the phyloseq object
ps <- phyloseq(
  otu_table(seqtab.nochim.full, taxa_are_rows = FALSE),
  tax_table(taxa),
  sample_data(sample_data_object)
)

# Apply filtering criteria
ps_filtered <- ps %>%
  tax_select(c("Chloroplast", "Mitochondria"), deselect = TRUE) %>%
  tax_filter(min_prevalence = 3)

# Verify metadata integrity in filtered object
nsamples(ps_filtered)
table(sample_data(ps_filtered)$Treatment, useNA = "ifany")

# Number of taxa remaining after filtering
ntaxa(ps_filtered)

# Save the filtered phyloseq object
saveRDS(ps_filtered, "ps_filtered.rds")

# Export the ASV and taxonomy tables after filtering
# Convert OTU table to a data frame and then to a tibble
otu_table_df <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_filtered))
otu_table_tibble <- as_tibble(otu_table_df, rownames = "sample_name") 
write_tsv(otu_table_tibble, "filtered_asv_table.tab")

# Convert taxonomy table to a data frame and then to a tibble
tax_table_df <- as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_filtered))
tax_table_tibble <- as_tibble(tax_table_df, rownames = "ASV")  
write_tsv(tax_table_tibble, "filtered_taxa_table.tab")

```



#Alpha diversity based on effective species(Week0 to Week12)
```{r}
# Load necessary libraries
library(microViz)
library(phyloseq)
library(ggpubr)
library(cowplot)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(broom.mixed)


# Calculate effective species diversity 
alpha_div <- ps_filtered %>%
  ps_calc_diversity(rank = "unique", index = "shannon", exp = TRUE) %>%
  ps_calc_diversity(rank = "unique", index = "gini_simpson", exp = FALSE) %>%
  ps_mutate(gini_simpson_unique_eff = 1 / (1 - gini_simpson_unique)) %>%
  samdat_tbl()


# Subset the data to include only Week 0 and Week 12
filtered_alpha <- alpha_div %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(0, 12)) %>%
  select(-.sample_name) %>%  
  mutate(
    Week = factor(Week), 
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Cracker", "Almond"))
  )


# Define color palette
primary.colpal <- c("Cracker" = "red", "Almond" = "blue") 

# Define a unified theme for plots
common_theme <- theme_pubr(base_size = 10) +  
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),    
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),    
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),   
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),   
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),    
    legend.title = element_blank()            
  )

# Create the Shannon plot
shannon.p <- ggboxplot(
  data = filtered_alpha,
  x = "Week",
  y = "exp_shannon_unique",
  ylab = "Shannon Entropy",  
  fill = "Treatment",
  palette = primary.colpal,
  ggtheme = common_theme,
  outlier.shape = 16,
  outlier.size = 2
) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test", 
    paired = TRUE,
    label = "p.format",
    size = 5,
    label.y = 35
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Treatment, strip.position = "bottom") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

# Create the Gini-Simpson plot 
simpson.p <- ggboxplot(
  data = filtered_alpha,
  x = "Week",
  y = "gini_simpson_unique_eff",
  ylab = "Gini-Simpson",  
  fill = "Treatment",
  palette = primary.colpal,
  ggtheme = common_theme,
  outlier.shape = 16,
  outlier.size = 2
) +
  stat_compare_means(
    method = "wilcox.test",
    paired = TRUE,
    label = "p.format",
    size = 5,
    label.y = 25 
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ Treatment, strip.position = "bottom") +
  theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_blank())

# Combine the plots
combined_plot <- ggarrange(
  shannon.p, simpson.p,
  common.legend = TRUE,
  legend = "right",  
  ncol = 1
) +
  theme(plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))

# Add title and save the final plot 
final_plot <- annotate_figure(
  combined_plot,
  top = text_grob("Alpha Diversity Analysis", size = 14, face = "bold")  
)

# Save and display the final plot
cowplot::save_plot("alpha_diversity_filtered.png", final_plot, base_height = 10, base_width = 8)
print(final_plot)



# Calculate IQR for Shannon Entropy
shannon_q1 <- quantile(filtered_alpha$exp_shannon_unique, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
shannon_q3 <- quantile(filtered_alpha$exp_shannon_unique, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
shannon_iqr <- shannon_q3 - shannon_q1
shannon_lower_bound <- shannon_q1 - 1.5 * shannon_iqr
shannon_upper_bound <- shannon_q3 + 1.5 * shannon_iqr

# Calculate IQR for Gini-Simpson
simpson_q1 <- quantile(filtered_alpha$gini_simpson_unique_eff, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
simpson_q3 <- quantile(filtered_alpha$gini_simpson_unique_eff, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
simpson_iqr <- simpson_q3 - simpson_q1
simpson_lower_bound <- simpson_q1 - 1.5 * simpson_iqr
simpson_upper_bound <- simpson_q3 + 1.5 * simpson_iqr

# Identify outliers
outliers_shannon <- filtered_alpha %>%
  filter(exp_shannon_unique < shannon_lower_bound | exp_shannon_unique > shannon_upper_bound)

outliers_simpson <- filtered_alpha %>%
  filter(gini_simpson_unique_eff < simpson_lower_bound | gini_simpson_unique_eff > simpson_upper_bound)

# Combine all outliers into one dataset
outliers_data <- bind_rows(
  mutate(outliers_shannon, Metric = "Shannon Entropy"),
  mutate(outliers_simpson, Metric = "Gini-Simpson")
)

filtered_alpha <- alpha_div %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(0, 12)) %>%
  select(-.sample_name) %>%
  mutate(
    ID = if_else(ID == "ALM105_5", "ALM105_12", ID),
    subject = sub("_(0|4|12)$", "", ID),
    Week = factor(Week, levels = c(0, 12)),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Cracker", "Almond"))
  ) %>%
  group_by(subject) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(Week) == 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(Treatment, subject, Week)

table(filtered_alpha$Week, filtered_alpha$Treatment)

filtered_alpha %>%
  filter(subject == "ALM105") %>%
  select(ID, subject, Week, Treatment)

# Define color palette
primary.colpal <- c(
  "Cracker" = "red",
  "Almond" = "blue"
)

# Define a common theme
common_theme <- theme_pubr(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 12),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 11,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    legend.position = "none")



# REVISED
# Shannon effective number of species
shannon.p <- ggboxplot(
  data = filtered_alpha,
  x = "Week",
  y = "exp_shannon_unique",
  fill = "Treatment",
  palette = primary.colpal,
  ggtheme = common_theme,
  outlier.shape = 16,
  outlier.size = 2,
  width = 0.65
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Treatment,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )


# Simpson effective number of species
simpson.p <- ggboxplot(
  data = filtered_alpha,
  x = "Week",
  y = "gini_simpson_unique_eff",
  fill = "Treatment",
  palette = primary.colpal,
  ggtheme = common_theme,
  outlier.shape = 16,
  outlier.size = 2,
  width = 0.65
) +
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Treatment,
    nrow = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL
  ) +
  theme(
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none",

    axis.title.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),

    axis.text.y = element_text(
      size = 10,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

final_plot <- ggarrange(
  shannon.p,
  simpson.p,
  ncol = 1,
  nrow = 2,
  align = "v",
  heights = c(1, 1)
)

print(final_plot)
```







# Beta Diversity excluding week4
```{r}
library(phyloseq)
library(microViz)
library(vegan)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggvegan)


#outliers <- c("ALM004_12", "ALM011_0", "ALM011_12", "ALM013_0", 
             # "ALM099_0", "ALM099_12", "ALM102_12", "ALM149_0", "ALM161_12")

ps2 <- readRDS("ps_filtered (2).rds")
ps2 <- ps2 %>%
  tax_transform("compositional") %>%
  ps_filter (Week %in% c(0,12)) 
  #ps_filter(!ID %in% outliers)


# Get OTU table and Sample data
otu.df <- ps2 %>% otu_get() %>% data.frame()

samdat <- ps2 %>%
  samdat_tbl()%>%
  dplyr::select(-.sample_name)
  

# Ensure Week is numeric
  samdat$Week <- as.numeric(as.character(samdat$Week))
  
# Ensure Treatment and Week are factors
samdat$Treatment <- factor(samdat$Treatment,  labels = c("Cracker", "Almond"))
samdat$Week <- factor(samdat$Week, levels = c(0,12), labels = c("Week0", "Week12"))


# Bray-Curtis dissimilarity and square root transformation
bray <- vegdist(otu.df, method = "bray") %>% sqrt()

# Run dbRDA
set.seed(12345)
dbrda.res <- dbrda(bray ~ Treatment*Week, data = samdat)
anova_b <- anova(dbrda.res, by = "terms", permutations = 999)
print(anova_b)

# Calculate % Variance explained
dbrda.res.eigenvals <- eigenvals(dbrda.res)
p.explained <- dbrda.res.eigenvals[c("dbRDA1", "dbRDA2")] / sum(dbrda.res.eigenvals) * 100

# Get site scores
scores_df <- as.data.frame(scores(dbrda.res, display = "sites"))

# Add sample metadata (merge with samdat by rownames)
scores_df$ID <- rownames(scores_df)
samdat$ID <- as.character(samdat$ID)

# Merge scores with sample metadata
plot_df <- left_join(scores_df, samdat, by = "ID")

# Extract biplot arrows
arrow_df <- as.data.frame(scores(dbrda.res, display = "bp"))
arrow_df$Variable <- rownames(arrow_df)

arrow_df$dbRDA1 <- arrow_df$dbRDA1 * 1.5 
arrow_df$dbRDA2 <- arrow_df$dbRDA2 * 1.5


#  dbRDA plot
dbrda.p <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = dbRDA1, y = dbRDA2)) +
  geom_point(aes(fill = Treatment, shape = Week),
             size = 2.3, alpha = 1,
             color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +

  geom_segment(data = arrow_df,
               aes(x = 0, y = 0, xend = dbRDA1, yend = dbRDA2),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.25, "cm")),
               color = "black", size = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1", name = "Treatment") +
  scale_shape_manual(name = "Week", values = c("Week0" = 21, "Week12" = 22)) +

  guides(color = "none", fill = guide_legend(override.aes = list(shape = 21))) +

  xlab(paste0("dbRDA1 [", sprintf("%.2f", p.explained[1]), "%]")) +
  ylab(paste0("dbRDA2 [", sprintf("%.2f", p.explained[2]), "%]")) +
  theme_classic()

cowplot::save_plot("dbRDA_Week012.png", dbrda.p, base_height = 5, base_width = 7, dpi = 300)


# PERMANOVA test
set.seed(12345)
adonis2(bray ~ Treatment * Week, data = samdat, by = "term", permutations = 999)

# Test for homogeneity of dispersion
set.seed(12345)
betadisper(bray, samdat$Treatment) %>% permutest()






#### Check the difference at baseline and week 12 separately
# Subset based on week
ps_week0 <- ps2 %>% ps_filter(Week == 0)
ps_week12 <- ps2 %>% ps_filter(Week == 12)


# Week0
otu0 <- otu_get(ps_week0)
meta0 <- samdat_tbl(ps_week0)
bray0 <- vegdist(otu0, "bray")
set.seed(12345)
adonis2(bray0 ~ Treatment, data = meta0)

# Week 12
otu12 <- otu_get(ps_week12)
meta12 <- samdat_tbl(ps_week12)
bray12 <- vegdist(otu12, method = "bray")
set.seed(12345)
adonis2(bray12 ~ Treatment, data = meta12)


###### Subset to Almond

ps_almond <- ps2 %>%
  ps_filter(Treatment == "Almond", Week %in% c(0,12))

otu_almond <- otu_get(ps_almond)
meta_almond <- samdat_tbl(ps_almond)
bray_almond <- vegdist(otu_almond, method = "bray")

# Check if week is a factor
meta_almond$Week <- factor(meta_almond$Week)

set.seed(12345)
adonis2(bray_almond ~ Week, data = meta_almond)

###### Subset to Cracker

ps_cracker <- ps2 %>%
  ps_filter(Treatment == "Cracker", Week %in% c(0,12))

otu_cracker <- otu_get(ps_cracker)
meta_cracker <- samdat_tbl(ps_cracker)
bray_cracker <- vegdist(otu_cracker, method = "bray")

# Check if week is a factor
meta_cracker$Week <- factor(meta_cracker$Week)

set.seed(12345)
adonis2(bray_cracker ~ Week, data = meta_cracker)
```

# Bayesian Differential Abundance Analysis
```{r}
# Bayesian Differential Abundance Analysis

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(tidyverse)
  library(phyloseq)
  library(microViz)
  library(rstanarm)
  library(posterior)
  library(emmeans)
  library(purrr)
})


# Load and prepare data
ps_filtered <- readRDS("ps_filtered (2).rds")

genus_df <- tax_glom(ps_filtered, taxrank = "Genus", NArm = TRUE) %>%
  ps_melt() %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = if_else(Sample == "ALM105_5", "ALM105_12", Sample),
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Cracker", "Almond")),
    Week = factor(
      Week,
      levels = c(0, 4, 12),
      labels = c("Week0", "Week4", "Week12")
    ),
    Subject = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Sanity checks
stopifnot(all(is.finite(genus_df$total)))
stopifnot(all(genus_df$total > 0))
stopifnot(all(genus_df$Abundance >= 0))
stopifnot(all(!is.na(genus_df$Subject)))


# Filter very sparse genera
filter_sparse <- TRUE
min_nonzero_samples <- 10

if (filter_sparse) {
  
  genus_sparsity <- genus_df %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    summarise(
      n_samples = n_distinct(Sample),
      nonzero_n = sum(Abundance > 0),
      prevalence = nonzero_n / n_samples,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  keep_genera <- genus_sparsity %>%
    filter(nonzero_n >= min_nonzero_samples) %>%
    pull(Genus)
  
  cat(
    "Before filtering genera:",
    n_distinct(genus_df$Genus),
    "\n"
  )
  
  genus_df <- genus_df %>%
    filter(Genus %in% keep_genera)
  
  cat(
    "After filtering genera:",
    n_distinct(genus_df$Genus),
    "\n"
  )
  
  saveRDS(
    genus_sparsity,
    "genus_sparsity_summary.rds"
  )
}


# Nest by Genus
nested_data <- genus_df %>%

# Bayesian model function
run_bayes <- function(
    df,
    link = "log",
    chains = 4,
    iter = 4000,
    adapt_delta = 0.99,
    seed = 12345
) {
  
  rstanarm::stan_glmer(
    Abundance ~
      Treatment * Week +
      offset(log(total)) +
      (1 | Subject),
    data = df,
    family = rstanarm::neg_binomial_2(link = link),
    prior_intercept = rstanarm::normal(-4, 1),
    prior = rstanarm::normal(0, 0.5),
    chains = chains,
    iter = iter,
    adapt_delta = adapt_delta,
    seed = seed,
    refresh = 0
  )
}


# Run models safely and capture warnings/errors

      error_obj,

    ),

  ) %>%

# Standardize credible interval column names
standardize_ci_cols <- function(df) {
  
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  nms <- names(df)
  
  lower_candidates <- c(
    "lower.HPD",
    "lower.CL",
    "asymp.LCL",
    "LCL",
    "lower"
  )
  
  upper_candidates <- c(
    "upper.HPD",
    "upper.CL",
    "asymp.UCL",
    "UCL",
    "upper"
  )
  
  lower_col <- intersect(
    lower_candidates,
    nms
  )[1]
  
  upper_col <- intersect(
    upper_candidates,
    nms
  )[1]
  
  if (!is.na(lower_col) && !is.na(upper_col)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      rename(
        conf.low = all_of(lower_col),
        conf.high = all_of(upper_col)
      )
    
  } else if (all(c("estimate", "SE") %in% nms)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * SE,
        conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * SE
      )
    
  } else if (all(c("estimate", "std.error") %in% nms)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      mutate(
        conf.low = estimate - 1.96 * std.error,
        conf.high = estimate + 1.96 * std.error
      )
    
  } else {
    
    stop(
      "Cannot find CI columns or compute them. Columns are: ",
      paste(nms, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }
  
  if ("SE" %in% names(df) &&
      !"std.error" %in% names(df)) {
    
    df <- df %>%
      rename(
        std.error = SE
      )
  }
  
  df
}


# Calculate Bayesian contrasts
run_emmeans_bayes <- function(
    fit_obj,
    debug = FALSE
) {
  
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(
    fit_obj,
    ~ Treatment * Week,
    at = list(
      Treatment = c("Cracker", "Almond"),
      Week = c("Week0", "Week4", "Week12")
    )
  )
  
  ctr <- emmeans::contrast(
    emm,
    method = list(
      "ALM4_vs_ALM0" = c(0, -1, 0, 1, 0, 0),
      "ALM12_vs_ALM0" = c(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, 1),
      "ALM12_vs_ALM4" = c(0, 0, 0, -1, 0, 1),
      "CRK4_vs_CRK0" = c(-1, 0, 1, 0, 0, 0),
      "CRK12_vs_CRK0" = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0),
      "CRK12_vs_CRK4" = c(0, 0, -1, 0, 1, 0),
      "ALM0_vs_CRK0" = c(-1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0),
      "ALM4_vs_CRK4" = c(0, 0, -1, 1, 0, 0),
      "ALM12_vs_CRK12" = c(0, 0, 0, 0, -1, 1)
    )
  )
  
  ci_obj <- try(
    confint(ctr),
    silent = TRUE
  )
  
  if (!inherits(ci_obj, "try-error")) {
    
    ci_df <- as.data.frame(ci_obj)
    
    if (debug) {
      cat("\n[DEBUG] confint(ctr) columns:\n")
      print(names(ci_df))
      
      cat("[DEBUG] head(confint):\n")
      print(utils::head(ci_df))
    }
    
    out <- standardize_ci_cols(ci_df)
    
  } else {
    
    td <- broom::tidy(ctr)
    
    if (debug) {
      cat("\n[DEBUG] broom::tidy(ctr) columns:\n")
      print(names(td))
      
      cat("[DEBUG] head(tidy):\n")
      print(utils::head(td))
    }
    
    out <- standardize_ci_cols(td)
  }
  
  out
}

# Bayesian Differential Abundance Analysis

# Libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(tibble)
library(posterior)
library(rstan)
library(rstanarm)
library(phyloseq)
library(microViz)
library(ggplot2)
library(forcats)
library(cowplot)


# Load Bayesian outputs
emm_sig <- readRDS("bayes_emmeans_significant.rds")
bayes_results_clean <- readRDS("bayes_results_clean.rds")


# MCMC diagnostic function
get_mcmc_diag <- function(fit_obj) {
  
  fixef_terms <- names(rstanarm::fixef(fit_obj))
  
  posterior::summarise_draws(
    posterior::as_draws_array(fit_obj),
    "rhat", "ess_bulk", "ess_tail"
  ) %>%
    tibble::as_tibble() %>%
    dplyr::rename(term = variable) %>%
    dplyr::filter(term %in% fixef_terms)
}


# Divergence function
get_divergences <- function(fit_obj) {
  
  sp <- rstan::get_sampler_params(
    fit_obj$stanfit,
    inc_warmup = FALSE
  )
  
  sum(sapply(sp, function(x) sum(x[, "divergent__"])))
}


# Extract models for genera with significant contrasts
sig_genera <- unique(emm_sig$Genus)

bayes_sig_models <- bayes_results_clean %>%
  filter(Genus %in% sig_genera)


# Run MCMC diagnostics
diag_sig <- bayes_sig_models %>%
  mutate(
    diag = purrr::map(fit, get_mcmc_diag),
    n_divergent = purrr::map_int(fit, get_divergences)
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(diag)


# Flag unreliable model parameters
diag_flagged <- diag_sig %>%
  mutate(
    bad = rhat > 1.01 |
      ess_bulk < 400 |
      ess_tail < 400 |
      n_divergent > 0
  )


# Identify genera with any problematic model parameter
bad_genera <- diag_flagged %>%
  filter(bad) %>%
  distinct(Genus)


# Identify genera with acceptable diagnostics
good_genera <- diag_flagged %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    any_bad = any(bad),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!any_bad) %>%
  pull(Genus)


# Keep significant contrasts from reliable models
emm_sig_reliable <- emm_sig %>%
  filter(Genus %in% good_genera)


# Summarize diagnostics for reliable genera
diag_reliable_summary <- diag_sig %>%
  filter(Genus %in% unique(emm_sig_reliable$Genus)) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    max_rhat = max(rhat, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_bulk = min(ess_bulk, na.rm = TRUE),
    min_ess_tail = min(ess_tail, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_n_divergent = max(n_divergent, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(max_rhat))


# Save diagnostic results
saveRDS(diag_sig, "bayes_diagnostics_significant_genera.rds")
saveRDS(diag_reliable_summary, "bayes_diagnostics_reliable_genera.rds")
saveRDS(emm_sig_reliable, "bayes_emmeans_significant_reliable.rds")


# Function to get posterior draws for contrasts
get_contrast_draws <- function(fit_obj) {
  
  draws <- posterior::as_draws_df(fit_obj)
  
  b_trt <- "TreatmentAlmond"
  b_w4 <- "WeekWeek4"
  b_w12 <- "WeekWeek12"
  b_i4 <- "TreatmentAlmond:WeekWeek4"
  b_i12 <- "TreatmentAlmond:WeekWeek12"
  
  needed <- c(b_trt, b_w4, b_w12, b_i4, b_i12)
  
  if (!all(needed %in% names(draws))) {
    stop("Missing coefficients")
  }
  
  out <- tibble::tibble(
    ALM4_vs_ALM0 = draws[[b_w4]] + draws[[b_i4]],
    
    ALM12_vs_ALM0 = draws[[b_w12]] + draws[[b_i12]],
    
    ALM12_vs_ALM4 =
      (draws[[b_w12]] - draws[[b_w4]]) +
      (draws[[b_i12]] - draws[[b_i4]]),
    
    CRK4_vs_CRK0 = draws[[b_w4]],
    
    CRK12_vs_CRK0 = draws[[b_w12]],
    
    CRK12_vs_CRK4 =
      draws[[b_w12]] - draws[[b_w4]],
    
    ALM0_vs_CRK0 = draws[[b_trt]],
    
    ALM4_vs_CRK4 =
      draws[[b_trt]] + draws[[b_i4]],
    
    ALM12_vs_CRK12 =
      draws[[b_trt]] + draws[[b_i12]]
  )
  
  out %>%
    tibble::rowid_to_column("draw_id") %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols = -draw_id,
      names_to = "contrast",
      values_to = ".draw"
    )
}


# Function to calculate PD and ROPE
compute_pd_rope <- function(
    draws_df,
    rope_low = log(0.9),
    rope_high = log(1.1)
) {
  
  draws_df %>%
    group_by(contrast) %>%
    summarise(
      estimate = median(.draw),
      conf.low = quantile(.draw, 0.025),
      conf.high = quantile(.draw, 0.975),
      
      pd = max(
        mean(.draw > 0),
        mean(.draw < 0)
      ),
      
      prop_in_rope =
        mean(.draw >= rope_low & .draw <= rope_high),
      
      prop_outside_rope =
        1 - prop_in_rope,
      
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}


# Calculate PD and ROPE for reliable significant genera
pd_rope_results <- bayes_results_clean %>%
  filter(Genus %in% emm_sig_reliable$Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    draws = purrr::map(fit, get_contrast_draws)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(Genus, draws) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(draws) %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  group_modify(~ compute_pd_rope(.x)) %>%
  ungroup()


# Merge PD and ROPE with significant reliable contrasts
bayes_final <- emm_sig_reliable %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Genus,
    contrast,
    estimate,
    conf.low,
    conf.high
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    pd_rope_results %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Genus,
        contrast,
        pd,
        prop_in_rope,
        prop_outside_rope
      ),
    by = c("Genus", "contrast")
  )


# Classify results using PD and ROPE
final_scored <- bayes_final %>%
  mutate(
    conclusion = case_when(
      
      pd >= 0.99 &
        prop_in_rope < 0.05 ~
        "Strong evidence of meaningful effect",
      
      pd >= 0.95 &
        prop_in_rope < 0.20 ~
        "Probable meaningful effect",
      
      pd >= 0.95 &
        prop_in_rope >= 0.20 ~
        "Probable direction, negligible magnitude",
      
      pd < 0.95 &
        prop_in_rope < 0.20 ~
        "Uncertain direction, meaningful if real",
      
      TRUE ~
        "No evidence of meaningful effect"
    )
  )


# Convert log-scale estimates to fold-change ratio
final_scored <- final_scored %>%
  mutate(
    ratio = exp(estimate),
    lo = exp(conf.low),
    hi = exp(conf.high)
  )


# Save scored Bayesian results
saveRDS(final_scored, "bayes_final_scored.rds")


# Load and prepare genus abundance data
ps_filtered <- readRDS("ps_filtered (2).rds")

genus_df <- tax_glom(
  ps_filtered,
  taxrank = "Genus",
  NArm = TRUE
) %>%
  ps_melt() %>%
  mutate(
    Sample = if_else(
      Sample == "ALM105_5",
      "ALM105_12",
      Sample
    ),
    Treatment = factor(
      Treatment,
      levels = c("Cracker", "Almond")
    ),
    Week = factor(
      Week,
      levels = c(0, 4, 12),
      labels = c("Week0", "Week4", "Week12")
    ),
    Subject = sub("_[^_]+$", "", Sample)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(-ID) %>%
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(
    total = sum(Abundance)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Calculate relative abundance
abundance_df <- genus_df %>%
  mutate(
    RelAbundance = Abundance / total
  )


# Calculate median relative abundance by group and time
median_rel_abundance <- abundance_df %>%
  group_by(Genus, Treatment, Week) %>%
  summarise(
    median_ref_abundance =
      median(RelAbundance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


# Define reference group for each contrast
ref_map <- tibble::tribble(
  ~contrast,           ~Treatment, ~Week,
  "ALM4_vs_ALM0",      "Almond",   "Week0",
  "ALM12_vs_ALM0",     "Almond",   "Week0",
  "ALM12_vs_ALM4",     "Almond",   "Week4",
  "CRK4_vs_CRK0",      "Cracker",  "Week0",
  "CRK12_vs_CRK0",     "Cracker",  "Week0",
  "CRK12_vs_CRK4",     "Cracker",  "Week4",
  "ALM0_vs_CRK0",      "Cracker",  "Week0",
  "ALM4_vs_CRK4",      "Cracker",  "Week4",
  "ALM12_vs_CRK12",    "Cracker",  "Week12"
)


# Add reference-group abundance to Bayesian results
final_plot_df <- final_scored %>%
  left_join(
    ref_map,
    by = "contrast"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    median_rel_abundance,
    by = c("Genus", "Treatment", "Week")
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    median_ref_abundance_pct =

  )


# Save final plotting data

# Forest plot data for Almond Week12 vs Week0

  filter(

# Helper to prepare relative abundance data for boxplots
make_halfmin_plot_data <- function(
    df,
    genera,
    treatment_keep,
    week_keep
) {
  
  df %>%
    filter(
      Genus %in% genera,
      Treatment %in% treatment_keep,
      Week %in% week_keep
    ) %>%
    group_by(Genus) %>%
    mutate(
      min_nonzero = ifelse(
        any(RelAbundance > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
        min(
          RelAbundance[RelAbundance > 0],
          na.rm = TRUE
        ),
        NA_real_
      ),
      halfmin = min_nonzero / 2,
      RelAbundance_plot = ifelse(
        RelAbundance == 0,
        halfmin,
        RelAbundance
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(!is.na(RelAbundance_plot))
}

  geom_point(
    shape = 21,
    size = 1.5,
    stroke = 0.2,
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.2)
  ) +
  
  scale_y_log10() +
  
  facet_wrap(
    ~ Genus,
    scales = "free_y"
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Week0" = "skyblue",
      "Week12" = "skyblue3"
    )
  ) +
  
  labs(
    y = "Relative Abundance",
    x = "Week",
    title = "Almond Week12 vs Week0"
  ) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_text(
      size = 6,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1,
      size = 8
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.position = "top",
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

print(p_box_ALM12)
```

# ASV Level Diff On Selected Taxa
```{r}
# Libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(glmmTMB)
library(broom.mixed)
library(emmeans)

target_genera <- c("Bifidobacterium", "Roseburia", "Faecalibacterium", "Lachnospiraceae",
                   "Phascolarctobacterium", "Tyzzerella", "Bacteroides","Lachnospira",
                   "Ruminiclostridium","Ruminococcus","Phocaeicola","Dorea",
                   "Lactobacillus","Dialister","Clostridium", "Lacrimispora","Blautia",
                   "Collinsella", "Monoglobus", " Eubacterium", "Oscillospira")


# Filter Phyloseq Object to target genera
target_ps <- ps_filtered %>% subset_taxa(Genus %in% target_genera)

# Melte phyloseq to long format
melted_asv <- ps_melt(target_ps)

# Set Treatment and Week Baseline levels
melted_asv <- melted_asv %>%
  dplyr::select(-ID, dplyr::everything()) %>% 
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Cracker", "Almond")),
    Week      = factor(Week,
                       levels = c(0, 4, 12),
                       labels = c("Week0", "Week4", "Week12"))
  ) %>%
  # add total counts per sample
  group_by(Sample) %>%
  mutate(total = sum(Abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Define a Function to run NB
glmm_asv_nb <- function(df) {
  glmmTMB(
    Abundance ~ Treatment * Week + (1 | Sample),
    family = nbinom2,
    data   = df,
    offset = log(total)
  )
}

# safe version
safe_nb <- purrr::possibly(glmm_asv_nb, otherwise = NULL)

View(melted_asv)

# fit one model per ASV
glmm_asv<- melted_asv %>%
  group_by(Genus, OTU) %>%
  nest(data = -c(Genus, OTU)) %>%
         ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, safe_nb)
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(fit, is.null))

glmm_asv_tidy <- glmm_asv %>%
  mutate(
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidied)


asv_tidy <- glmm_asv %>%
  mutate(
    tidied = purrr::map(
      fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed")
    )
  ) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(tidied) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  filter(
    is.finite(estimate),
    !is.na(p.value),
    abs(estimate) < 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr")
  )


# Get the raw orders
emmeans(glmm_asv$fit[[1]], ~ Treatment * Week) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::select(Treatment, Week)


# Apply Emmeans based on Costume Contrasts
emmeans_asv <- function(model) {
  tryCatch({
    emmeans(model, ~ Treatment * Week) %>%
      contrast(method = list(
        "ALM4_vs_ALM0"   = c(0, -1, 0,  1, 0, 0),
        "ALM12_vs_ALM0"  = c(0, -1, 0,  0, 0, 1),
        "ALM12_vs_ALM4"  = c(0,  0, 0, -1, 0, 1),
        "CRK4_vs_CRK0"   = c(-1, 0, 1,  0, 0, 0),
        "CRK12_vs_CRK0"  = c(-1, 0, 0,  0, 1, 0),
        "CRK12_vs_CRK4"  = c(0,  0,-1,  0, 1, 0),
        "ALM0_vs_CRK0"   = c(-1, 1, 0,  0, 0, 0),
        "ALM4_vs_CRK4"   = c(0,  0,-1,  1, 0, 0),
        "ALM12_vs_CRK12" = c(0,  0, 0,  0,-1, 1)
      )) %>%
      broom::tidy()
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
}


interaction_emms_asv <- glmm_asv %>%
  mutate(emms = purrr::map(fit, emmeans_asv)) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(emms, is.null)) %>%
  unnest(emms) %>%
  rename(contrast = contrast) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

# Sig Results Only
sig_asv <- interaction_emms_asv %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.10)

view(sig_asv)

view(interaction_emms_asv)



# bky adjustment
interaction_emms_asv <- glmm_asv %>%
  mutate(
    emms_interaction = purrr::map(fit, ~ emmeans_asv(.x))
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(Genus, emms_interaction) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(emms_interaction) %>%
  mutate(
    p.adj_bky = cp4p::adjust.p(p.value, pi0.method = "bky", alpha = 0.1)$adjp[,2]
  )

bky_asv <- interaction_emms_asv %>%
  filter(p.adj_bky < 0.1)
view(bky_asv)


```








# Partial Correlation Analysis, Almond Only
```{r}
# Load libraries

library(phyloseq)
library(microbiome)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(broom)
library(purrr)
library(pheatmap)
library(ppcor)
library(cowplot)
library(viridis)


# Prepare phyloseq and metadata

# Phyloseq object
ps_n <- ps_filtered

# Correct sample name
sample_names(ps_n)[sample_names(ps_n) == "ALM105_5"] <- "ALM105_12"

# Read metadata
metadata <- read.csv(
  "Biomarker_Metadata.csv",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)


# Rename Subject column to ID
colnames(metadata)[colnames(metadata) == "Subject"] <- "ID"

# Set row names of metadata
rownames(metadata) <- metadata$ID

# Reorder metadata to match phyloseq sample order
metadata <- metadata[
  sample_names(ps_n),,
  drop = FALSE]


# Replace metadata in phyloseq object
sample_data(ps_n) <- sample_data(metadata)


id_col <- "ID"
week_col <- "Week"


# Aggregate at genus level
ps_genera <- microbiome::aggregate_taxa(
  ps_n,
  level = "Genus")

# Subset Phyloseq object to almond group
almond_ids <- as(sample_data(ps_n), "data.frame") %>%
  dplyr::filter(Treatment == 1) %>%
  dplyr::pull(ID)


# Subset full phyloseq object
ps_almond <- prune_samples(
  almond_ids,
  ps_n
)


# Aggregate Almond object at genus level
ps_almond_ag <- microbiome::aggregate_taxa(
  ps_almond,
  level = "Genus"
)


# Confirm Almond-only object
table(as(sample_data(ps_almond_ag), "data.frame")$Treatment)


### Week4

# Split significant genera based on contrasts
sig_Almond_4 <- final_scored %>%
  dplyr::filter(contrast %in% c( "ALM4_vs_ALM0", "ALM4_vs_CRK4" )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::pull(Genus) %>%
  unique()

# Subset Almond phyloseq object to Week 4
week4_ids <- grep("_4$",sample_names(ps_almond_ag),value = TRUE)

ps_almond_4 <- prune_samples(week4_ids,ps_almond_ag)


# Confirm one Week 4 sample per subject
subject_4 <- sub( "_(0|4|12)$", "", sample_names(ps_almond_4))


stopifnot(
  anyDuplicated(subject_4) == 0
)


# Extarct significant genera and do clr transformation

# Subset phyloseq object for significant genera
ps_siga_4 <- subset_taxa(ps_almond_4,Genus %in% sig_Almond_4)


# CLR transformation
ps_clra_4 <- microbiome::transform(ps_siga_4,"clr")


# Extract CLR-transformed abundance table
clr_abundance_4 <- otu_table(ps_clra_4)


if (taxa_are_rows(ps_clra_4)) {
  clr_abundance_4 <- t(clr_abundance_4)
}


# Convert to data frame
clr_abundance_4 <- as.data.frame(clr_abundance_4)


# Extract week4 biomarker delta values
delta_all_4 <- as(sample_data(ps_almond_4), "data.frame") %>%
  dplyr::select(ends_with("d4")) %>%
  dplyr::select( -matches( "Acetic_d4|Propionic_d4|Butyric_d4|Valeric_d4|Lactic_d4|SCFAs_d4"
    ))


# Mean-impute missing Calprotectin_d4 values
delta_all_4$Calprotectin_d4[is.na(delta_all_4$Calprotectin_d4)] <- mean(
  delta_all_4$Calprotectin_d4,na.rm = TRUE)

# Sign log transformation function
log_transform <- function(x) sign(x) * log1p(abs(x))

# Log-transform delta values 
delta_all_4 <- delta_all_4 %>%
  mutate(across(everything(),log_transform))


# Match taxa and biomarker rows
samples_all_4 <- intersect(rownames(clr_abundance_4), rownames(delta_all_4))


clr_matched_4 <- clr_abundance_4[samples_all_4,,drop = FALSE]

delta4_all_matched <- delta_all_4[
  samples_all_4,,drop = FALSE]


# Week 4 confounders
df_meta_4 <- as(sample_data(ps_almond_4),"data.frame")


confounders_4 <- df_meta_4[,c("Age", "Sex", "BMI"),drop = FALSE]

# Recode sex
confounders_4$Sex_recoded <- dplyr::recode(
  confounders_4$Sex,
  "NonBinary" = "F",
  "Transgender" = "M",
  .default = confounders_4$Sex)


confounders_4$Sex_num <- ifelse(confounders_4$Sex_recoded == "M",1,0)


confounder_4 <- data.frame(
  Age = as.numeric(confounders_4$Age),
  Sex_num = as.numeric(confounders_4$Sex_num),
  BMI = as.numeric(confounders_4$BMI),
  row.names = rownames(confounders_4)
)


# Align all objects
samps_4 <- Reduce(intersect,list(
    rownames(clr_matched_4),
    rownames(delta4_all_matched),
    rownames(confounder_4)
  ))


clr_matched_4 <- clr_matched_4[samps_4,, drop = FALSE]


delta4_all_matched <- delta4_all_matched[samps_4,, drop = FALSE]


confounder_4 <- confounder_4[samps_4,,drop = FALSE]


# Confirm exact alignment
stopifnot(
  identical(
    rownames(clr_matched_4),
    rownames(delta4_all_matched)
  ),
  identical(
    rownames(clr_matched_4),
    rownames(confounder_4)
  )
)


c(CLR_samples = nrow(clr_matched_4),Biomarker_samples = nrow(delta4_all_matched),
  Confounder_samples = nrow(confounder_4))


# Build Week 4 genus-biomarker pairs
genus_biom_4 <- tidyr::expand_grid(
  Genus = colnames(clr_matched_4),
  Biomarker = colnames(delta4_all_matched))


# Partial correlation function
partial_cor_4 <- function(genus, biomarker) {
  x <- clr_matched_4[[genus]]
  y <- delta4_all_matched[[biomarker]]
  tt <- ppcor::pcor.test(x,y,z = as.matrix(confounder_4), method = "spearman")
  tibble::tibble(Genus = genus,Biomarker = biomarker,r = unname(tt$estimate),
    p = unname(tt$p.value))}


# Run Correlation with P adjustment
alpha <- 0.10

results_p4 <- purrr::pmap_dfr(genus_biom_4,~ partial_cor_4(..1, ..2)) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(q_bh_global = p.adjust(p,method = "fdr"))


# Filter significant correlations
results_sig4_bh <- results_p4 %>%
  dplyr::filter(q_bh_global < alpha) %>% dplyr::arrange(q_bh_global)


### Week 12
# Split significant genera based on contrasts
sig_Almond_12 <- final_scored %>%

  ) %>%

# Subset Almond phyloseq object to Week 12
week12_ids <- grep( "_12$",sample_names(ps_almond_ag),value = TRUE)


ps_almond_12 <- prune_samples(
  week12_ids, ps_almond_ag)

# Confirm one Week 12 sample per subject
subject_12 <- sub("_(0|4|12)$","", sample_names(ps_almond_12))


stopifnot(anyDuplicated(subject_12) == 0)


# Select significant genera and perform cl transformation
ps_siga_12 <- subset_taxa(ps_almond_12,Genus %in% sig_Almond_12)

ps_clra_12 <- microbiome::transform(ps_siga_12,"clr")


# Extract CLR-transformed abundance table
clr_abundance_12 <- otu_table(ps_clra_12)

if (taxa_are_rows(ps_clra_12)) {
  clr_abundance_12 <- t(clr_abundance_12)
}


# Convert to data frame
clr_abundance_12 <- as.data.frame(clr_abundance_12)



# Extract Week 12 biomarker delta values
delta_all_12 <- as(sample_data(ps_almond_12), "data.frame") %>%
  dplyr::select(ends_with("d12")) %>%

    -matches(

    )
  )


# Mean-impute missing Calprotectin_d12 values
delta_all_12$Calprotectin_d12[
  is.na(delta_all_12$Calprotectin_d12)
] <- mean(
  delta_all_12$Calprotectin_d12,

)


# Apply the same transformation used for Week 4
delta_all_12 <- delta_all_12 %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    dplyr::across(
      dplyr::everything(),
      log_transform
    )
  )


# Match Week 12 CLR and biomarker rows
samples_all_12 <- intersect(
  rownames(clr_abundance_12),
  rownames(delta_all_12))

clr_matched_12 <- clr_abundance_12[samples_all_12,,drop = FALSE]


delta12_all_matched <- delta_all_12[samples_all_12,,drop = FALSE]



# Build Week 12 confounders
df_meta_12 <- as(sample_data(ps_almond_12),"data.frame")

confounders_12 <- df_meta_12[,c("Age", "Sex", "BMI"),drop = FALSE]


# Recode sex
confounders_12$Sex_recoded <- dplyr::recode(confounders_12$Sex,
  "NonBinary" = "F",

  .default = confounders_12$Sex)


confounders_12$Sex_num <- ifelse(confounders_12$Sex_recoded == "M",1,0)


confounder_12 <- data.frame(

  BMI = as.numeric(confounders_12$BMI),

# Align all thre objects together
samps_12 <- Reduce(intersect,

stopifnot(

clr_matched_12 <- clr_matched_12[samps_12,,drop = FALSE]

# Confirm exact alignment

c(CLR_samples = nrow(clr_matched_12),

# Build Week 12 genus-biomarker pairs

# Define Week 12 correlation function
partial_cor_12 <- function(genus, biomarker) {

# Prepare data for heatmap
mk_star <- function(df, qcol, alpha = 0.10) {
  df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      star = ifelse(
        .data[[qcol]] < alpha,
        "*",
        "")) %>%
    dplyr::select(Genus,Biomarker,star) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Biomarker,values_from = star) %>%
    tibble::column_to_rownames("Genus") %>%
    as.matrix() %>%
    t()}

)

star_bh_t12 <- star_bh_t12[biomarker_order_12,, drop = FALSE]


# Rename rows with full biomarker labels
rownames(corr_matrix_t12) <- biomarker_labels[rownames(corr_matrix_t12)]

rownames(star_bh_t12) <- biomarker_labels[rownames(star_bh_t12)]


# Plot Week 12 heatmap
pheatmap(

    title = "Erysipelotrichaceae UCG-003 vs Calprotectin"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(

    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15)
  )

p5
```

# Responder, NonResponder based on different Biomarkers
```{r}
# Load Libraries
library(phyloseq)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)


# Read  metadata
metadata <- read.csv("Biomarker_Metadata.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

## LDL_C
# Prepare data
id_col <- "ID"
week_col <- "Week"
trt_col <- "Treatment"
ldl_col <- "LDL.C"
delta_col <- "LDL.C_d12"

# Extract almond IDs
almond_meta <- as(sample_data(ps_n), "data.frame")
almond_meta <- almond_meta %>%
  mutate(Subject = str_replace(!! sym(id_col), "_(0|4|12)", ""))


# Collapse to one row
subj_tab <- almond_meta %>% arrange(Subject, !!sym(week_col)) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(
    Treatment = dplyr::first( !! sym(trt_col)),
    LDL.C_d12 = dplyr::first(!! sym(delta_col)),
    .groups = "drop")
 

# Add Responder, Non_responder lables
subj_tab <- subj_tab %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = case_when(
      Treatment == 1 & LDL.C_d12 <= thr_moderate ~ "Responder",
      Treatment == 1                           ~ "NonResponder",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_))

# Sensitivity check based on fixed thresholds
subj_tab <- subj_tab %>%
  mutate(
    resp_5 = ifelse(Treatment == 1 & LDL.C_d12 <= 0.05, "Responder",
                     ifelse(Treatment == 1 , "NonResponder", NA)),
    resp_10 = ifelse(Treatment == 1 & LDL.C_d12 <= 0.1, "Responder",
                     ifelse(Treatment == 1, "NonResponder", NA)))
  


# Build subject level baseline LDL (% of changes from baseline)
ldl_wide <- almond_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, !!sym(week_col), !!sym(trt_col), !!sym(ldl_col)) %>%
  mutate(Week = !!sym(week_col)) %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(0, 12)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Treatment = !!sym(trt_col), Week, LDL = !!sym(ldl_col)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = LDL, names_prefix = "wk") %>%
  mutate(pct_delta = (wk12 - wk0) /wk0,
         pct_delta_percent = pct_delta*100)

# Remove the outlier
out_ctrl <- c("ALM099")
ldl_clean <- ldl_wide %>%
  filter(!(Treatment == 0 & Subject %in% out_ctrl))


almond_labels <- ldl_wide %>%
  filter(Treatment == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_5  = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.05, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_10 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.10, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_15 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_16 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.16, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_17 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.17, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_18 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.18, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_19 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.19, "Responder", "NonResponder"),)


cracker_labels <- ldl_clean %>%
  filter(Treatment == 0) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_5  = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.05, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_10 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.10, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_15 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_16 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.16, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_17 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.17, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_18 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.18, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_19 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.19, "Responder", "NonResponder"),)

                   "ALM113", "ALM120", "ALM140", "ALM004", "ALM027", "ALM001",
                   "ALM006", "ALM090", "ALM103", "ALM179")


##  Basic column names 
id_col    <- "ID"
week_col  <- "Week"
trt_col   <- "Treatment"
cal_col   <- "Calprotectin"
delta_col <- "Calprotectin_d4"

# Extract metadata and create Subject 

almond_meta <- as(sample_data(ps_n), "data.frame") %>%
  mutate(
    Subject = str_replace(!!sym(id_col), "_(0|4|12)$", ""))

# Wide table of calprotectin (wk0 & wk4) and % change 

cal_wide <- almond_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, !!sym(week_col), !!sym(trt_col), !!sym(cal_col)) %>%
  mutate(Week = !!sym(week_col)) %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(0, 4)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Treatment = !!sym(trt_col), Week, CAL = !!sym(cal_col)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = CAL, names_prefix = "wk") %>%
  mutate(
    pct_delta         = (wk4 - wk0) / wk0,          
    pct_delta_percent = pct_delta * 100 )

#Restrict to inflamed subjects 

cal_inf <- cal_wide %>%
  filter(Subject %in% inflamed_both)

# Optionally remove missing subject 
out_alm <- "ALM022"
cal_inf <- cal_inf %>%
  filter(Subject != out_alm)


# Define responder / non-responder labels in inflamed subjects

# Almond arm only (inflamed)
almond_inflm <- cal_inf %>%
  filter(Treatment == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_15      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_20      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.20,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_25      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.25,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_30      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.30,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_35      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.35,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_40      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.40,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_45      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.45,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_50      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.50,        "Responder","NonResponder"))

# Cracker arm only (inflamed)
cracker_inflm <- cal_inf %>%
  filter(Treatment == 0) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_15      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_20      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.20,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_25      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.25,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_30      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.30,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_35      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.35,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_40      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.40,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_45      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.45,        "Responder","NonResponder"),
    resp_50      = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.50,        "Responder","NonResponder"))


##  Stack Almond + Cracker, reshape rules long --------------------------

dat_inf <- bind_rows(
  almond_inflm %>% mutate(Treatment = "Almond"),
  cracker_inflm %>% mutate(Treatment = "Cracker")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Subject, Treatment,
    resp_primary, resp_15, resp_20, resp_25, resp_30,resp_35, resp_40, resp_45, resp_50) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = starts_with("resp_"),
    names_to  = "rule",
    values_to = "resp") %>%
  filter(!is.na(resp)) %>%
  mutate(
    Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Cracker","Almond")),
    resp      = factor(resp, levels = c("NonResponder","Responder")))

# MPO -------------------------------------------------------------------------
id_col <- "ID"
week_col <- "Week"
trt_col <- "Treatment"
mpo_col <- "MPO"
delta_col <- "MPO_d4"

# Extract almond IDs
almond_meta <- as(sample_data(ps_n), "data.frame")
almond_meta <- almond_meta %>%
  mutate(Subject = str_replace(!! sym(id_col), "_(0|4|12)", ""))


# Collapse to 1 row
subj_tab <- almond_meta %>%
  arrange(Subject, !!sym(week_col)) %>%
  group_by(Subject) %>%
  summarise(
    Treatment = dplyr::first( !! sym(trt_col)),
    MPO_d4 = dplyr::first(!! sym(delta_col)),
    .groups = "drop")



# Add Responder, Non_responder lables
subj_tab <- subj_tab %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = case_when(
      Treatment == 1 & MPO_d4 <= thr_moderate ~ "Responder",
      Treatment == 1                           ~ "NonResponder",
      TRUE                                     ~ NA_character_))

# Sensitivity check based on fixed thresholds
subj_tab <- subj_tab %>%
  mutate(
    resp_15 = ifelse(Treatment == 1 & MPO_d4 <= 0.15, "Responder",
                     ifelse(Treatment == 1 , "NonResponder", NA)),
    resp_20 = ifelse(Treatment == 1 & MPO_d4 <= 0.2, "Responder",
                     ifelse(Treatment == 1, "NonResponder", NA)))
  
# Build subject level baseline mpo (% of changes from baseline)
mpo_wide <- almond_meta %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, !!sym(week_col), !!sym(trt_col), !!sym(mpo_col)) %>%
  mutate(Week = !!sym(week_col)) %>%
  filter(Week %in% c(0, 4)) %>%
  dplyr::select(Subject, Treatment = !!sym(trt_col), Week, MPO = !!sym(mpo_col)) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from = Week, values_from = MPO, names_prefix = "wk") %>%
  mutate(pct_delta = (wk4 - wk0) /wk0,
         pct_delta_percent = pct_delta*100)




almpo_labels <- mpo_wide %>%
  filter(Treatment == 1) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_15  = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_20 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.20, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_25 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.25, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_30 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.30, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_35 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.35, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_40 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.4, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_45 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.45, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_50 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.5, "Responder", "NonResponder"),)

crampo_labels <- mpo_wide %>%
  filter(Treatment == 0) %>%
  mutate(
    resp_primary = ifelse(pct_delta <= thr_moderate2, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_15  = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.15, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_20 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.20, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_25 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.25, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_30 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.30, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_35 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.35, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_40 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.4, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_45 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.45, "Responder", "NonResponder"),
    resp_50 = ifelse(pct_delta <= -0.5, "Responder", "NonResponder"),)
```

# Differential abundance analysis based on Responder/NonResponders (15% Reduction in LDL-C)
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(microViz)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)

# NB Model With Prevalence Cut-off
almond_melt <- melted_data %>%
  mutate(Subject = sub("_(0|4|12)$", "", Sample)) %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Almond")

almond_melted <- almond_melt %>%
  left_join( almond_labels %>% 
      mutate(resp_15 = factor(resp_15, levels = c("NonResponder", "Responder"))),
    by = "Subject") %>%
  mutate(
    Week    = fct_relevel(Week, "Week0","Week4","Week12"),
    resp_15 = fct_relevel(resp_15, "NonResponder","Responder"),
    Genus   = as.character(Genus))


# Set a Prevalence Filter
prev_cutoff <- 0.10   

prev_tab <- almond_melted %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    prev = mean(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop")

keep_genera <- prev_tab %>%
  filter(prev >= prev_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Genus)

almond_filt <- almond_melted %>%
  filter(Genus %in% keep_genera)


# Define GLMM function
glmm_resp <- function(df){
  glmmTMB(
    Abundance ~ resp_15 * Week + (1 | Subject),
    family = nbinom2,
    data   = df,
    offset = log(total))
}

safe_glmm_resp <- purrr::possibly(glmm_resp, otherwise = NULL)

# Fit a Model for one Genus only
almond_fit <- almond_filt %>%
  nest(data = -Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, safe_glmm_resp)  
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(fit, is.null))


# Tidy Fixed Effects Per Model
almond_tidy <- almond_fit %>%
  mutate(
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidied) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  filter(is.finite(estimate), !is.na(p.value)) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))


# Custom Emmeans Contrasts
run_emmeans_resp <- function(model){
  emms <- emmeans(model, ~ resp_15 * Week)

  emmeans::contrast(
    emms,
    method = list(
      "R_vs_NR_W0"  = c(-1, +1,  0,  0,  0,  0),
      "R_vs_NR_W4"  = c( 0,  0, -1, +1,  0,  0),
      "R_vs_NR_W12" = c( 0,  0,  0,  0, -1, +1),
      "R_W4_vs_R_W0"  = c(0, -1, 0, +1, 0, 0),
      "R_W12_vs_R_W0" = c(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, +1),
      "NR_W4_vs_NR_W0"  = c(-1, 0, +1, 0, 0, 0),
      "NR_W12_vs_NR_W0" = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, +1, 0)
    )
  ) %>% 
    broom::tidy()
}


emm_contr_filt <- almond_fit %>%
  mutate(
    emms_resp = purrr::map(fit, ~ tryCatch(run_emmeans_resp(.x), error = function(e) NULL))
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(emms_resp, is.null)) %>%
  unnest(emms_resp) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

# Extract Significant Contrasts
sig_fdr_ldl <- emm_contr_filt %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.1)




## Add Ratio + CI---------------------------------------------------------------
emm_contr_filt_rr <- emm_contr_filt %>%
  mutate(
    ratio   = exp(estimate),
    ci_low  = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    ci_high = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error))


```

```{r}
    emms_resp = purrr::map(fit, ~ tryCatch(run_emmeans_resp(.x), error = function(e) NULL))
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(emms_resp, is.null)) %>%
  unnest(emms_resp) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

# Extract Significant Contrasts
sig_nb_at <- emm_at_filt %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.10)

## Add Ratio + CI
emm_contr_filt_rr <- emm_contr_filt %>%
  mutate(
    ratio   = exp(estimate),
    ci_low  = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    ci_high = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error))

```




# Resp/Non-Resp NB Differential Abundance on Insulin (15% Reduction)
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(microViz)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(reshape2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(phyloseq)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(tidyverse)
library(glmmTMB)
library(emmeans)
library(purrr)
library(broom.mixed)


# NB Model With Prevalence Cut-off----------------------------------------------
almins_melt <- melted_data %>%
  mutate(Subject = sub("_(0|4|12)$", "", Sample)) %>%
  filter(Treatment == "Almond")

almins_melted <- almins_melt %>%
  left_join(
    alins_labels %>% 
      mutate(resp_15 = factor(resp_15, levels = c("NonResponder", "Responder"))),
    by = "Subject"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Week    = fct_relevel(Week, "Week0","Week4","Week12"),
    resp_15 = fct_relevel(resp_15, "NonResponder","Responder"),
    Genus   = as.character(Genus)
  )


# Set a Prevalence Filter
prev_cutoff <- 0.10   

prev_tab <- almins_melted %>%
  group_by(Genus) %>%
  summarise(
    prev = mean(Abundance > 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

keep_genera <- prev_tab %>%
  filter(prev >= prev_cutoff) %>%
  pull(Genus)

almins_filt <- almins_melted %>%
  filter(Genus %in% keep_genera)


# Define GLMM function
glmm_resp <- function(df){
  glmmTMB(
    Abundance ~ resp_15 * Week + (1 | Subject),
    family = nbinom2,
    data   = df,
    offset = log(total)
  )
}

safe_glmm_resp <- purrr::possibly(glmm_resp, otherwise = NULL)

# Fit a Model for one Genus only
almins_fit <- almins_filt %>%
  nest(data = -Genus) %>%
  mutate(
    fit = purrr::map(data, safe_glmm_resp)  
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(fit, is.null))


# Tidy Fixed Effects Per Model
almins_tidy <- almins_fit %>%
  mutate(
    tidied = purrr::map(fit, ~ broom.mixed::tidy(.x, effects = "fixed"))
  ) %>%
  unnest(tidied) %>%
  filter(term != "(Intercept)") %>%
  filter(is.finite(estimate), !is.na(p.value)) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))


# Costum Emmeans Contrasts
run_emmeans_resp <- function(model){
  emms <- emmeans(model, ~ resp_15 * Week)

  emmeans::contrast(
    emms,
    method = list(
      "R_vs_NR_W0"  = c(-1, +1,  0,  0,  0,  0),
      "R_vs_NR_W4"  = c( 0,  0, -1, +1,  0,  0),
      "R_vs_NR_W12" = c( 0,  0,  0,  0, -1, +1),
      "R_W4_vs_R_W0"  = c(0, -1, 0, +1, 0, 0),
      "R_W12_vs_R_W0" = c(0, -1, 0, 0, 0, +1),
      "NR_W4_vs_NR_W0"  = c(-1, 0, +1, 0, 0, 0),
      "NR_W12_vs_NR_W0" = c(-1, 0, 0, 0, +1, 0)
    )
  ) %>% 
    broom::tidy()
}


emm_ins_filt <- almins_fit %>%
  mutate(
    emms_resp = purrr::map(fit, ~ tryCatch(run_emmeans_resp(.x), error = function(e) NULL))
  ) %>%
  filter(!purrr::map_lgl(emms_resp, is.null)) %>%
  unnest(emms_resp) %>%
  mutate(p.adj = p.adjust(p.value, method = "fdr"))

# Extract Significant Contrasts
sig_nb_ins <- emm_ins_filt %>%
  filter(p.adj < 0.10)



## Add Ratio + CI
emm_contr_filt_rr <- emm_contr_filt %>%
  mutate(
    ratio   = exp(estimate),
    ci_low  = exp(estimate - 1.96 * std.error),
    ci_high = exp(estimate + 1.96 * std.error))

```

```{r}
# Test GLMM model on one analyte

fit_no_int <- update(fit_gam, . ~ . - treatment:week)

# Define a function for GLMM on all analytes
glmm_ox <- function(dat){
  dat <- dat |>
    dplyr::mutate(
      treatment = droplevels(factor(treatment)),
      week      = droplevels(factor(week)))
  tryCatch({
    fit_full  <- glmmTMB(value_imp ~ treatment*week + age + sex + bmi + (1|subject),
                         family = Gamma(link = "log"), data = dat)
    fit_noint <- update(fit_full, . ~ . - treatment:week)
    lrt <- anova(fit_full, fit_noint)
    tibble::tibble(
      p_int = lrt$`Pr(>Chisq)`[2],
      n     = nrow(dat))
  }, error = function(e) tibble::tibble(p_int = NA_real_, n = nrow(dat)))}

### Apply the function on all oxylipins

  group_by(analyte) %>%
  group_modify(~ glmm_ox(.x)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(p_int_fdr = p.adjust(p_int, "fdr"),
         p_int_q10 = p_int_fdr < q ) %>%
  arrange(p_int_fdr)



# Restrict Results to FDR 10%

  mutate(sig_int_q10  = p_int_fdr < q,
         sig_w12_q10  = p_w12_fdr < q)

res_glmm %>% filter(sig_w12_q10 == TRUE)
```
